draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 124th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 16th of 37 at CB. He went 102nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Kendall Fuller. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3 passes defended in 2019, 24th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2023. 42 career games and 11 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 3 AV in 2023. Weak spots: completion % allowed 70.2% (17th percentile).
